why: Mind map regrouped by what a thing is, per Gavin's feedback on the nesting

kb.label: IAA Alumni Meet & Greet
kb.body: Optional. The alumni association's own introduction session.

kb.label: PLDP intro webinar
kb.body: Zoom. Clarifies the P0 leadership assignments and how the coaching year works. INSEAD marks it MUST DO.

kb.label: AMA on student platforms
kb.body: Optional. Open questions on the LMS, CareerGlobe and the rest.

kb.label: INSEAD CV & Cover Letter webinar
kb.body: 13:00 Paris / 20:00 Singapore. What goes in the INSEAD format and what stays out, and when the CV work happens during the year.

kb.label: Academics overview webinar
kb.body: Zoom, with the MBA Programme Management Director and current students: the curriculum and how to prepare. Highly recommended.

kb.label: Your Summer Experience & Prep for Arrival webinar
kb.body: The three ways to spend the summer break -- an 8-week internship, a startup tour, or time off to prepare for recruitment.

kb.label: Business Foundations: register by 30 October
kb.body: One week online, 16-20 November. Intensive intro to Financial Accounting, Finance and Quantitative Methods for people without a quant background. Optional, registered through MyINSEAD.

kb.label: PLDP assignments window
kb.body: Online on the LMS. Your coach reads these before meeting you, so they shape the coaching you get. MUST DO.

kb.label: CareerLeader and Career Anchors, before the first coaching session
kb.body: Two questionnaires plus the workbook questions. They are the raw material for that first session, so turning up without them wastes the slot.

kb.label: Launch Week career pre-work appears on the LMS
kb.body: To be done before Launch Week, not during it.

kb.label: Launch Week
kb.body: Fontainebleau. The P1 core exemption exams sit inside it, alongside a lot of other sessions.

kb.label: Period dates, P1 to P5
kb.body: P1 18 Jan-10 Mar 27, P2 15 Mar-4 May 27, P3 10 May-30 Jun 27, P4 23 Aug-12 Oct 27, P5 18 Oct-4 Dec 27. INSEAD says these can still move.

kb.label: Campus exchange bidding happens during P1
kb.body: Exchange runs P3-P5; campus is Fontainebleau or Singapore for P1-P2. The rules can change year to year.

kb.label: Breaks
kb.body: 11-14 Mar, 5-9 May, summer 1 Jul-22 Aug, 13-17 Oct. Career and club treks run in the short ones.

kb.label: Graduation, Singapore
kb.body: Grad trip after.

kb.label: LMS goes live
kb.body: All academic content runs through it, some of the CDC curriculum too, and club registration as well.

kb.label: CareerGlobe goes live
kb.body: The CDC platform. The profile has to be set up before the first coaching appointment can be booked.

kb.label: VMock scores a CV draft
kb.body: Part 1 of the INSEAD CV process: it scores the draft and says what to fix before a human reads it.

kb.label: One INSEAD CV format, and the CV Book
kb.body: Used as a networking and marketing document, and the basis for the INSEAD CV Book. The process runs on through P1.

kb.label: Two teams behind you: a Career Coach and Employer Engagement
kb.body: That is the whole of CDC's structure. The coach is your primary contact; Employer Engagement is the sector expertise.

kb.label: Coaching sessions are 45 minutes and you set the agenda
kb.body: Short enough to fit before class. You bring the update and agree the next steps; the coach pressure-tests and plans.

kb.label: Your coach is allocated on P1 location and never changes
kb.body: Deliberately coach-agnostic, follows you the whole MBA, and there are no coach changes.

kb.label: First coaching session, from November
kb.body: Covers how the partnership works, what the profiling tools said, and the steps of the career journey.

kb.label: The career journey is three stages
kb.body: Self Awareness (strengths, interests, values), Market Exploration (industry knowledge through networking, narrowed to 2-3 target plans), Execution (a value proposition, recruiting to each sector's real timetable).

kb.label: Career switcher status decides how much of CDC is must-do
kb.body: Most CDC items are must-do for people switching Location, Sector or Function and only highly recommended for everyone else.

kb.label: Employer Engagement are Sector Advisors
kb.body: Subject-matter experts who spend half their time advising students and half talking to companies: market intelligence, who to connect with, sharpening a sector pitch, and offer negotiation.

kb.label: Careers Across Geographies & Sectors workshop
kb.body: For Fontainebleau and Singapore. CDC asks 27Ds not to book Sector Advisor appointments until after it, because most sector information is delivered there -- the one exception being early internship application roles.

kb.label: Company events, treks and the Industry Expert Series
kb.body: Pre-MBA company event invitations arrive through the Sunday newsletters. Treks, networking forums and the Tech Symposium run through the year.

kb.label: CDC's own key takeaways
kb.body: Networking is what works: alumni, target industry, classmates. Pick a few priorities rather than defaulting to consulting. Take a leadership role in a club. A radical career changer should start before the programme. Only apply where you genuinely fit.

kb.label: PLDP runs the whole year, not just P0
kb.body: Personal Leadership Development Programme: individual and group coaching, starting with the P0 assignments and continuing across the periods.

kb.label: Optional, 8 weeks in the break after P3
kb.body: A Short-Term Summer Project; the alternatives are a startup tour or time off to prepare for recruitment. Gavin's own plan is to start looking from the day the course starts.

kb.label: Recruiting runs through P2, and some internships start in June
kb.body: Early internship application roles are the one reason to contact Employer Engagement before the February workshop.

kb.label: Six P1 core courses
kb.body: Financial Accounting, Financial Markets & Valuation, Organisational Behaviour I, Prices & Markets, Uncertainty Data & Judgment, Introduction to Strategy.

kb.label: Pre-readings for Financial Accounting and Prices & Markets
kb.body: Book recommendations are on the MBA Journey pages. Highly recommended, not required.

kb.label: Core exemption exams
kb.body: P1 exemptions are examined in Launch Week; P2 and P3 exemptions during P1. Passing one frees a slot for an elective.

kb.label: Club introduction and registration, on the LMS
kb.body: Club leadership elections and the handover to 27Ds come in P1-P2.

kb.label: 27D Student Council and Student Rep elections
kb.body: Team diversity is a requirement.

kb.label: Who to email
kb.body: degree.programmes@insead.edu for programme questions, careerdevelopmentcentre@insead.edu for CDC.

notes.text:
Rebuilt the map the way you described. The top level is now what a thing is, not Academics/Career/Student Life: Webinars and sessions, Deadlines, Programme calendar, Platforms and tools, Coaching, The summer internship, Courses and exemptions, Clubs and elections, Who to contact.

Every row carries its date on the title line and its description underneath, both already on screen. Nothing nests below a group any more, so there is nothing to click into. Only the group header collapses, and it starts open.

Webinars sort by date, so the next one is the top row. Dropped the clutter you pointed at: the "P0 tells you to start early on visa and housing" line, MyINSEAD and the newsletters (both tasks are already Done), the P0 and Prioritisation framing nodes, and the "they coach, you play" one.
